purpose: Formalize the pre-decision semantic mapping f and the post-decision realized mapping z without exposing realized successor information before action selection.

pre_decision_mapping.f: A bijection from action identities to semantic structural-transformation profiles.
pre_decision_mapping.constraint: f is bijective within every decision unit.
pre_decision_mapping.agent_observation: For every candidate action a, the decision input exposes the structural profile P(f(a)).
pre_decision_mapping.reassignment: A permutation sigma of the four profiles changes f while preserving the action vocabulary and the marginal frequency of every profile.
pre_decision_mapping.identification_target: Selection variation attributable to the reassigned semantic profile, conditional on balanced action identity.

post_decision_realization.z: The deterministic simulator mapping from action identity to the realized successor structural profile.
post_decision_realization.surface_permuted_condition: z = rho_surface(f), where rho_surface is a fixed-point-free permutation used only to alter presentation realization correspondence without exposing the condition label.
post_decision_realization.contradictory_condition: z = rho_contradictory(f), where rho_contradictory is a fixed-point-free permutation distinct from rho_surface.
post_decision_realization.null_condition: z is generated independently of f and the selected action by a frozen deterministic procedure using the decision-unit identifiers and the requirements/semantics digest.
post_decision_realization.critical_rule: z and every variable derived from z are generated only after the action decision and are never included in the pre-decision prompt.

realized_state_and_transformation.successor_state: S_t+1 is generated deterministically from S_t and the selected action under z.
realized_state_and_transformation.realized_transformation: The realized transformation is derived only after action selection from the simulator transition.
realized_state_and_transformation.T_acc: T_acc,t+1 is derived from the realized successor state and simulator-defined transformation accessibility.

independence_requirements: must not use outcome or value variables
balance_requirements: same profile vocabulary as informative condition
same number of profiles per decision unit

invariants: f is bijective in every decision unit.
z is bijective in every realized decision unit.
Every action is paired with exactly one semantic profile before decision.
Every profile is assigned to exactly one action before decision.
The profile descriptor contains structural properties only.
No profile descriptor encodes desirability, reward, value, utility, performance or success.
z is never exposed before selection.
The null correspondence is independent of f and selected action.
Condition identifiers are metadata for analysis and reconstruction, not decision-agent inputs.

primary_contrast_binding.estimand: action_identity × future_profile_assignment interaction on selection probability
primary_contrast_binding.informative_vs_null: The primary null contrast compares informative correspondence against the matched uninformative correspondence.
primary_contrast_binding.reassignment_requirement: The same action identity must appear across multiple profile assignments with balanced frequencies.

required: verify profile semantics are identical between specification and implementation
verify null generator has no f/action dependency
verify z is generated after selection
verify condition metadata is excluded from decision input
verify no post-decision variable enters the prompt
pre_fixture_validation.failure_action: Do not generate or execute the scientific fixture if any validation fails.
